# Surfaces v18

- Starter sets changed: architecture. A new line: a need that is more of what the system already
  takes widens the existing input, setting or contract, and a new concept is added only where none
  can take it without changing what it means.
- The fit of starter lines to existing principles skills is stricter: a skill holds a starter line
  only where one of its lines states all of it, as `PRINCIPLES_SKILLS.md` → *With skills already in
  place* says. For each existing principles skill, offer once the starter lines it carries only in
  part — spread over several of its lines — as a sharpening of the nearest line or as a line of its
  own, with the new architecture line among them where the skill covers architecture.
